response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, t.type, t.amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.date > '1996-05-09' AND t.date < '1998-01-06'), r AS (SELECT region, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM j GROUP BY region), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS overall FROM r) SELECT r.region, r.avg_signed, r.txn_count, r.avg_signed / o.overall AS ratio_to_overall FROM r CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Transactions of type VYBER (undocumented direction), other types and NULL types are excluded from the signed average but still counted in the transaction count, as the request says.

The overall average is the unweighted mean of the regional averages. Regions whose average is NULL (no PRIJEM or VYDAJ rows) are skipped in that mean, but they still appear in the output with a NULL average and ratio.
